candidate_correspondence.explanation: Match final Git/source/grade/review identities and preserve temporal gaps; matched inventories establish only recorded-boundary correspondence.

requirements.evidence_needed: Frozen comparator observations on complete captured final source; accepted amendment receipt

requirements.requirement: Text and JSON share inventory collection and validation
requirements.evidence_needed: Semantic inspection of captured source; internal names and module layout are not fixed

requirements.requirement: User documentation accurately describes the final public interface
requirements.evidence_needed: Captured README/docs sections and request references

requirements.evidence_needed: Captured test source, original required command and successful output, complete same-item start/completion inventories matching final-source, and explicit timing/collection limits

requirements.explanation: Not assessed. This requirement grades the final task change, not every intermediate commit.

git_evidence_limits.baseline_construction: Recorded Git plumbing uses write-tree, commit-tree, and update-ref.
git_evidence_limits.explanation: Raw commit metadata and a cumulative patch do not reveal every intermediate commit diff; these defaults are limits, not runtime observations.

coordinator_work_window.explanation: Proposed start immediately after actual execution acceptance, before final freshness/admission checks; earlier preparation and waiting remain in full elapsed/cost accounting.

native_limit.explanation: Collector-enforced behavior is separately bound; coordinator stop rules do not establish hard whole-workflow enforcement.

unknown_reasons.measurements: This is an unexecuted template; no observed values are supplied.
unknown_reasons.whole_child_usage: Received author-stream events do not establish complete child usage or root/child inclusion.
unknown_reasons.equivalent_api_value: Requires supported counter scope, model/rate identities, and partition mapping.
unknown_reasons.actual_charges: Token counters do not establish actual billed charges.
unknown_reasons.operator_effort: Voluntary operator recording is optional; absence is unknown effort, not zero.

tool_inventory_scans.explanation: Index per-scan elapsed duration as observation overhead included in the native outer interval; do not add it again to whole elapsed or treat it as complete collector cost.

inference_limits: One ordinary episode establishes no population failure rate.
A completed turn and behavioral pass do not establish required review or full task completion.
An amended oracle after failed amendment delivery is diagnostic, not evidence of disobedience.
Research setup and grading costs are recorded separately from ordinary authoring work.
Full elapsed/cost accounting includes recurring preparation and acceptance waiting; the proposed coordinator work window begins only after actual acceptance.
Coordinator-window expiry creates no renewed authorization, retry, or replacement episode.
Git evidence grades the final task change relative to the seed; every intermediate commit diff remains unverified.
The native record scheme has not been exercised in an accepted episode; synthetic producer and collector checks do not establish native/profile/security acceptance.

assessment_evidence_format.selector: byte/line/JSON selector identifying the supporting observation

developer_test_correspondence.explanation: For each original required command and successful result, match the same thread/turn/tool item and complete start/completion inventories to final-source. Retain mismatches and missing boundaries. Equality establishes non-atomic received-event boundary correspondence, not continuous or exact execution-time stability; test adequacy and independent review are separate.
